claim: Dubai Friday evening brunches like Ammos Thalassa run roughly AED 295-525 per person depending on beverage package, served 7-11pm/8-11pm.
quote: Available Fridays 8pm-11pm with prices AED 295 (soft beverages), AED 355 (house beverages) and AED 395 (sparkling).

claim: Weekend brunch is a flagship Dubai social ritual, with Time Out cataloguing 95 top-rated 2026 brunch spots spanning a wide price range.
quote: Best brunches in Dubai 2026: 95 top-rated brunch spots to try next

claim: CE LA VI sits atop Address Sky View hotel in Downtown Dubai and is split into Restaurant, SkyBar, Club Lounge and Pool Deck with indoor/outdoor seating and poolside cabanas.
quote: CE LA VI ... divided into Restaurant, SkyBar, Club Lounge and Pool Deck, blending indoor and outdoor seating with dining tables, lounge spots and poolside cabanas.

claim: CE LA VI Dubai is on the 54th floor of Tower 2, Address Sky View, with uninterrupted panoramic views and a signature swing positioned in front of Burj Khalifa.
quote: 54th floor ... Tower 2, Address Sky View Hotel ... panoramic and uninterrupted views over Dubai ... an infinity pool and a swing positioned in front of Burj Khalifa.

claim: AURA Skypool on the 50th floor of The Palm Tower is suspended 210m up and is the world's highest 360-degree infinity pool, overlooking Palm Jumeirah and the Gulf.
quote: Perched on the 50th floor of The Palm Tower ... suspended 210 metres in the air and is home to the world's highest 360 infinity pool

claim: Sky Views Dubai observatory admission is AED 89 adult / AED 69 child (AED 59 UAE residents), open daily 10am-10pm, with a glass floor and glass slide between levels 53 and 52.
quote: Observatory General Admission for Adults (age 8+ years) is AED 89 ... A 46-metre glass floor and Glass Slide a transparent tube connecting level 53 with level 52

claim: The optional Sky Views Edge Walk, a hands-free walk on the tower's external perimeter, starts around AED 499.
quote: The Edge Walk experience ticket price starts at AED 499

claim: The Dubai Fountain at the foot of Burj Khalifa is a free choreographed water, light and music show on Burj Lake in Downtown Dubai.
quote: The Dubai Fountain ... a carefully choreographed dance of water, light, and music ... right at the foot of the world's tallest building.

claim: Dubai Fountain evening shows run every 30 minutes from 6pm to 11pm daily and are free from public promenade, bridge and Souk Al Bahar viewpoints; a paid Boardwalk gets within 9m for AED 20 (~US$5.60).
quote: evening shows take place every 30 minutes from 6 pm to 11 pm every day ... Tickets to access the 272-meter floating boardwalk cost AED 20 (US $5.60) ... within 9 meters of the fountain.

claim: Creek dhow dinner cruises through old Deira/Bur Dubai start around AED 50-100 (budget), while modern Marina dhow cruises are pricier at roughly AED 100-150 per person.
quote: Dubai Creek dhow cruise starts from just AED 65 ... Marina cruises start from AED 149 ... Dubai Creek Dhow Cruise is more budget friendly ... Marina cruise is a premium tour package

claim: The 220ft Lotus Megayacht runs a 7:30-10:30pm Marina dinner cruise from Pier 7 (boarding 6:45pm) past JBR, the Marina skyline and Palm Jumeirah, from about AED 249.
quote: MEGAYACHT DINNER CRUISE STANDARD (7:30Pm - 10:30Pm) Boarding 6:45Pm ... 220ft Lotus mega yacht ... Standard package: AED 249.00
